observation.command:
set -e
cd /workspace/.local-images/minio
cat > Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM alpine:3.20
RUN apk add --no-cache curl
COPY minio /usr/bin/minio
RUN chmod +x /usr/bin/minio && minio --version
USER 1000:1000
VOLUME /data
EXPOSE 9000 9001
EOF
docker build -q -t minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z .
cd /workspace/.local-images/mc
cat > Dockerfile <<'EOF'
FROM alpine:3.20
COPY mc /usr/local/bin/mc
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/mc && mc --version
EOF
docker build -q -t minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z .
docker images | grep minio
